adjudication.rationale: In EmbeddableHost (new file), the `before_validation` block unconditionally calls `self.host.sub!(...)` twice. If `self.host` is nil, this raises `NoMethodError`. In Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host, `host.host = params[:embeddable_host][:host]` assigns nil when the param/key is missing, and there is no presence check/guard before calling `host.save`, so a malformed create/update request can trigger the nil `sub!` and produce a 500 instead of a normal validation error.
